incidents.name: Revert Finance V3Utils unvalidated swap target
incidents.notes: V3Utils executed a caller-supplied swap target and calldata without validating it, so the attacker made the helper call transferFrom on tokens and pull balances from users who had approved it.

sources.ref: onchain review: V3Utils 0x531110418d8591C92e9cBBFC722Db8FFb604FAFD creation resolved over RPC to 2023-02-03T18:41:11Z (block 16550113) by 0x8df57e3d9ddde355dce1adb19ebce93419ffa0fb, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (14.4 days). lossUsd is the stablecoin leg observed in this transaction's receipt (19,305.58 + 500 USDC + 4,106.32 USDT, USD-pegged at 1:1); the attacker ran several such txs against different approvals, so the incident total is larger.
